# This datapack was created for my video to play with friends. Order datapack / other - [Discord](https://discord.gg/dCWyMsE94D).
This datapack was intended to randomize your attributes every 15 minutes.
### Download and play at your own risk.

<details>
<summary>What datapack does?</summary>

- Once the game starts, a 15-minute timer will start, which will restart every time period passed.
- The following attributes change:
<details>
<summary>Randomized attributes</summary>

1. attack_damage [0.0-3.999]
2. attack_knockback [0.0-3.999]
3. attack_speed [0.0-3.999]
4. block_break_speed [0.0-3.999]
5. block_interaction_range [2.0-10.999]
6. burning_time [0.0-0.99]
7. entity_interaction_range [2.0-10.999]
8. fall_damage_multiplier [0.0-2.999]
9. gravity [0.1-0.50]
10. jump_strength [0.1-1.999]
11. knockback_resistance [0.0-0.999]
12. max_health [10.0-40.0]
13. movement_efficiency [0.0-0.999]
14. movement_speed [0.1-0.29]
15. oxygen_bonus [0.0-3.999]
16. safe_fall_distance [0.0-10.999]
17. scale [0.0-3.999]
18. sneaking_speed [0.0-2.999]
19. step_height [0.0-4.999]
20. submerged_mining_speed [0.0-2.999]
21. water_movement_efficiency [0.0-1.999]

</details>

</details>

## Commands:
```
Start game - /function erkatom:start_game
Unstart game - /function erkatom:unstart_game
Skip timer - /function erkatom:skip
```
